question: Should this PR continue as a narrow assistant identity helper fix, or should it pause/close in favor of the owner-level cleanup requested on https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/102802?
rationale: A maintainer already rejected the same one-call-site helper substitution because it also changed the negative-limit contract, so automation should not override that direction.

options.title: Pause For Owner-Level Cleanup
options.body: Close or hold this PR and ask for a maintainer-owned cleanup that makes assistant identity length handling explicit before changing the helper contract.

options.title: Accept A Narrow Repair
options.body: Allow this PR to continue only after it preserves or explicitly documents the negative-limit behavior and adds real behavior proof.

recommendation.title: Pause For Owner-Level Cleanup
recommendation.body: Close or hold this PR and ask for a maintainer-owned cleanup that makes assistant identity length handling explicit before changing the helper contract.

likelyOwner.reason: They provided the clearest recent maintainer-visible decision on this exact assistant identity cleanup shape.
